mapper.update: update product set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update product set stock = stock + #{stock} ,update_time = now() where id = #{id} and stock + #{stock} >= 0 and (#{stock} >= 0 or status = 1)
update product set sales = sales + #{quantity},update_time = now() where id = #{id} and sales + #{quantity} >= 0
mapper.select: select p.*,c.name as categoryName from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.id = #{id}
select p.*,c.name as categoryName from product p left join category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.name = #{name}
select count(*) from product where category_id = #{categoryId}
select * from product where status = 1 and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') order by id asc
